license_overview: Films in this folder are Blender Foundation open movies. Films from 2006 use CC BY 2.5; films from 2008–2016 use CC BY 3.0; films from 2017 onward use CC BY 4.0. All files have been transcoded to HLS with a custom HDR bitrate ladder, sprite thumbnail strips, extracted subtitle tracks, and extracted font assets — constituting a derivative work. All CC BY versions permit derivatives with attribution.
